name: neiro-cli
description: Play a folder of music in your browser with a live spectrum visualizer. Streams from disk — nothing is uploaded.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const{cpSync,existsSync}=require('node:fs');if(!existsSync('../../dist/index.html')){console.error('Run `npm run build` at the repo root first.');process.exit(1)}cpSync('../../dist','ui',{recursive:true})"
